siteSettings.address: 38 Olanrewaju Ninalowo Crescent, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos State, Nigeria

services.title: Vocal Recording
services.tagline: Flawless vocal captures through reference tube & FET microphones in a zero-noise acoustic vault.
services.description: Step into an acoustically tuned isolation chamber engineered for total clarity, dynamic intimacy, and vocal punch. Captured through our vintage Neumann U87 Ai and Sony C-800G chain with Tube-Tech CL 1B optical leveling.
preparationReqs: Instrumental stem or stereo backing track

services.title: Music Production & Beat-Making
services.tagline: Custom production, modern Afrobeats grooves, cinematic textures, and bespoke chord progressions.
services.description: Collaborate with our in-house multi-instrumentalists and production architects. We sculpt custom sonics from scratch or build around your melody loops using hybrid analog synthesizers and pristine drums.

services.title: Analog & Hybrid Mixing
services.tagline: Transform raw multitrack recordings into deep, punchy, commercially competitive records.
services.description: Individual track balance, surgical EQ, harmonic saturation, dynamic compression, stereo staging, and spatial reverb placement through our SSL AWS console and boutique outboard rack.

services.title: Precision Stereo & Dolby Atmos Mastering
services.tagline: The final polish that ensures your music sounds monumental across streaming, radio, and club systems.
services.description: Critical acoustic monitoring in our treated mastering suite. Harmonic excitation, dynamic stereo imaging, peak control, and true-peak loudness calibration adhering strictly to Spotify, Apple Music, and club playback specs.
processSteps: Analog chain pass (Pultec EQ & Rupert Neve MBT)
preparationReqs: Final uncompressed stereo mix (-6dB headroom, no limiter on master)

services.title: Complete Mixing & Mastering Bundle
services.tagline: The end-to-end sonic treatment. Full multitrack mix down combined with final competitive mastering.
services.description: Seamless synergy between our mixing engineers and mastering suite. Includes 3 free revision rounds, all stem variations, and streaming-ready delivery.
services.verifiedRoom: The Analog Control Room & Mastering Suite

services.title: Full Record Production
services.tagline: From raw melody to finished billboard-ready record: songwriting, beat, tracking, mixing & master.
services.description: Comprehensive artist development package. Our head producer and engineering staff partner with you through pre-production, chord styling, vocal directing, full instrumentation, and complete post-production.

services.title: Vocal Production, Editing & Tuning
services.tagline: Transparent pitch correction, manual Melodyne alignment, pocket timing, harmonies & background vocal stacking.
services.description: Elevate raw vocal takes into pristine, modern radio perfection. We specialize in natural Melodyne note shaping, tight vocAlign phrase locking, and lush harmonic widening.
deliverables: Clean vocal stems ready for mixing
preparationReqs: Backing music track with clear key reference

services.title: Broadcast Podcast Recording
services.tagline: Multi-microphone broadcast podcast sessions with real-time monitoring and pristine acoustic isolation.
services.description: Accommodates up to 4 hosts and remote guests. Equipped with Shure SM7B broadcast microphones, Cloudlifter preamps, multi-camera lighting setup, and isolated headphone feeds.
preparationReqs: Guest list & remote call links (if any)

services.title: Voice-Over & Commercial Narration
services.tagline: Ultra-low noise floor vocal captures for commercials, audiobooks, dubbing, and video game dialogues.
services.description: Dedicated sound design and voice-over engineering with real-time producer remote talkback via Source-Connect or Zoom. Broadcast compliant mastering available.
deliverables: De-breathed and edited final master audio
processSteps: Direct mic tracking with pop filtering
preparationReqs: Pronunciation guide for specific brand/character names

equipment.name: U87 Ai Large-Diaphragm Condenser
equipment.description: The global standard for vocal clarity and acoustic intimacy. Dual-diaphragm capsule with omni, cardioid, and figure-8 switchable patterns.

equipment.name: C-800G Studio Tube Microphone
equipment.description: Legendary high-end tube microphone featuring an external Peltier thermoelectric cooling system. Renowned for silky modern highs and present lead vocals.

equipment.name: CL 1B Optical Tube Compressor
equipment.description: All-tube optical compressor celebrated for effortless, transparent vocal leveling without transient squashing or harsh coloration.

equipment.name: 1073SPX Discrete Microphone Preamp & EQ
equipment.description: Handcrafted British Class A discrete circuit with Marinair transformers delivering unmistakable punch, thick low-mids, and musical sheen.

specs.EQ Bands: High shelf 12kHz, Mid peak with selectable Q, Low shelf

equipment.name: AWS 948 Delta Hybrid SuperAnalogue Console
equipment.description: 48 inputs of SSL SuperAnalogue summing with dual-channel EQ, G-Series bus compressor, and automated motorized DAW fader integration.
applications: Tracking sessions with instant DAW recall

equipment.name: The Ones 8351B Coaxial Active Monitors
equipment.description: Three-way point-source coaxial monitors featuring Smart Active Monitor DSP room correction for pinpoint stereo imaging and zero phase distortion.

equipment.name: Subsequent 37 Paraphonic Analog Synthesizer
equipment.description: Two-note paraphonic analog synthesizer with dual oscillators, sub-oscillator, multidrive saturation, and the legendary Moog ladder filter.

equipment.name: SM7B Dynamic Vocal Microphone
equipment.description: Smooth, flat, wide-range frequency response suitable for broadcast speech, rock vocals, podcasts, and brass tracking.

projects.title: Lagos Sunrise (Afrobeats Anthem)

credits.studioRoom: The Vocal Booth & Analog Control Room

projects.caseStudyOverview: Uplifting 106 BPM Afrobeats anthem tracked through the Sony C-800G into Neve 1073 and Tube-Tech CL 1B. Featuring driving four-on-the-floor kick, resonant African log drum bounce, Kalimba plucks, and live Lagos brass section.

projects.title: Kairo Nights (Amapiano Heavyweight Beat)

credits.recordedBy: SonicVault Sound Lab (Akai MPC Live II)

projects.caseStudyOverview: South African Amapiano heavyweight production featuring deep resonant FM log-drum pitch glides, rolling triplet shakers, atmospheric Fender Rhodes 9th chords, and club-shaking sub-bass low-end translation.

projects.title: Phantom Sub (Hip-Hop & Trap 808 Instrumental)
projects.caseStudyOverview: Hard-hitting 140 BPM Trap instrumental sculpted with thunderous sliding 808 sub-bass glides, rapid 32nd hi-hat rolls, snapping trap snares, and dark minor analog bell chord progressions.

projects.title: Kingston Heatwave (Reggae Dancehall & Dub)

credits.recordedBy: The Live Recording Room & Vocal Chamber
credits.studioRoom: The Live Recording Room & Mastering Suite

projects.caseStudyOverview: Authentic 96 BPM Kingston-style Reggae Dancehall dub session. Authentic one-drop drums, sharp staccato offbeat guitar and organ skanks, deep dub sub-bass, and analog spring reverb tape echo throws.

projects.title: Blue Note Lekki (Acoustic Jazz Quartet)
projects.caseStudyOverview: Recorded live in our acoustically tuned live room with Coles 4038 ribbon microphones. Features acoustic upright walking double bass, classic swung ride cymbal tap, warm Rhodes II-V-I chords, and muted saxophone phrasing.

projects.title: Golden Groove (1970s Slap Funk Production)

credits.recordedBy: The Analog Control Room & Live Room

projects.caseStudyOverview: High-octane 1970s slap funk production driven by syncopated thumb-slap bass and string pops, rhythmic wah-style guitar chops, crisp acoustic snare on 2 and 4, and dynamic brass horn stabs.

projects.title: Velvet Heartstrings (Classic Motown Soul)

credits.recordedBy: Neumann U87 Ai Matched Stereo Pair

projects.caseStudyOverview: Deep Motown soul session captured on the Neumann U87 Ai through vintage Teletronix LA-2A optical compression. Features warm flat-wound electric bass, vintage Fender Rhodes vibrato, lush string pads, and emotive vocal runs.

projects.title: Brixton Nocturne (UK Drill Rap Type Beat)
projects.caseStudyOverview: Gritty 142 BPM UK Drill rap type beat built around signature sliding octave pitch-glide 808 basslines, syncopated triplet hi-hat skips, hard offbeat counter-snares, and dark gothic minor piano stabs.

projects.title: Palmwine Serenade (West African Highlife)

credits.recordedBy: The Live Recording Room & Vocal Booth

projects.caseStudyOverview: Timeless West African highlife celebration tracking dual clean interlocking guitars, traditional talking drums with real-time pitch bends, joyful live brass section harmonies, and buoyant melodic bass.

projects.title: Overdrive Anthem (Modern Alt-Rock Production)

credits.recordedBy: Shure SM7B on Marshall 4x12 Cab & Live Drums
credits.studioRoom: The Live Recording Room & Control Room

projects.caseStudyOverview: Energetic modern rock production featuring overdriven Marshall tube power chords, driving acoustic drum kit, crash cymbal wash, aggressive picked bassline, and soaring alternative rock vocals.

projects.title: Neon Starlight (Synthpop & Pop Radio Single)

credits.mixedBy: SSL AWS 948 Delta & Rupert Neve MBT

projects.caseStudyOverview: Polished radio-ready commercial pop anthem featuring four-on-the-floor dance kick, sidechained pumping synth bass, shimmering saw-synth poly-chords, crisp digital handclaps, and infectious synthpop arpeggios.

projects.title: Midnight Satin (Intimate R&B & Neo-Soul Session)
projects.caseStudyOverview: Sensual 82 BPM R&B / Neo-Soul showcase tracked in Dolby Atmos. Features Fender Rhodes major 9th chords, unhurried pocket drums with rim clicks, warm sub-bass, and silky smooth multi-track vocal harmonies.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What is SonicVault Studios?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: SONICVAULT STUDIOS is a premier music recording, production, mixing, and mastering studio situated at 38 Olanrewaju Ninalowo Crescent, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria. Our mission is Where Sound Becomes Art.

chatbotKnowledge.question: Where are you located and what are your opening hours?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: We are located at 38 Olanrewaju Ninalowo Crescent, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos State, Nigeria. We operate 24/7 strictly by appointment to guarantee artists complete privacy and unbroken creative flow.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What services do you offer at SonicVault?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: We provide Vocal Recording, Music Production & Beatmaking, Analog & Hybrid Mixing, Precision Mastering, Vocal Tuning & Comping, and Broadcast Podcast/Voice-over recording in our specialized acoustically treated rooms.

chatbotKnowledge.question: How much are your studio rates and session prices?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Our proposed starting rates begin at ₦35,000 for a 1-hour vocal recording session and scale with lockout packages and multi-track production bundles. All final rates are calculated dynamically during booking and confirmed with our studio director.

chatbotKnowledge.question: How do I book a session and make payment?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: You can book directly through our online booking portal at /book-session or click "Book a Session". We accept secure payments and deposits via Paystack (card, bank transfer, USSD). A deposit secures your exclusive room time.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What gear and microphones do you have in the studio?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: The Vault is equipped with reference instruments and analog hardware including the Sony C-800G tube microphone, Neumann U87 Ai, Tube-Tech CL 1B compressor, Neve 1073SPX, SSL AWS 948 Delta console, and Genelec 8351B point-source monitors.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What are the acoustical specifications and isolation ratings of your chambers?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Every chamber at SonicVault is physically decoupled on floating concrete slabs to deliver -85dB isolation between concurrent sessions, meeting NC-15 background noise criteria with calibrated timber diffusers and bass absorption.

chatbotKnowledge.question: How should I prepare stems and multitrack sessions for mixing or mastering?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Export 24-bit or 32-bit float WAV/AIFF stems at 44.1kHz or 48kHz, all consolidated from timecode 0:00:00 with bypass on master bus limiters and dithering. Include rough mixes and key/tempo metadata.

chatbotKnowledge.question: Do you offer full-day lockouts or multi-day album production packages?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Yes. We offer 12-hour full facility lockouts and multi-day production residencies. Lockouts include private lounge privileges, unmetered access to all analog outboard chains, and dedicated sound engineers.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What payment methods do you accept, and is a deposit required?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: We accept secure online payments via Paystack including Nigerian debit/credit cards, bank transfers, and USSD. A 50% deposit is required to lock in your confirmed calendar slot, with the balance cleared prior to stem delivery.

chatbotKnowledge.question: How do I speak to a live studio engineer or manager on WhatsApp?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: You can reach our studio manager immediately on WhatsApp at +2349015104502 or click the floating WhatsApp button on your screen. You can also call 09015104502 or email Sonicvaultstudios@gmail.com.
